Operations.Name: MailSend
Operations.Description: Sends mail using configured mail settings.

Arguments.Name: config
Arguments.Description: Optional mail configuration overrides for this message.

Fields.Name: Fromemail
Fields.Description: The sending address that the mail server will use for sending emails.

Fields.Name: Fromname
Fields.Description: Display name that will appear as the sender name in outgoing emails.

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Unique identifier for this mail configuration.

Fields.Name: Oauth
Fields.Description: OAuth configuration for email providers that support it or `null` for basic authentication.

Fields.Name: Outgoingserver
Fields.Description: Hostname or IP address of the SMTP server used for sending emails.

Fields.Name: Pass
Fields.Description: SMTP password.

Fields.Name: Port
Fields.Description: TCP port number for the SMTP server connection.

Fields.Name: Security
Fields.Description: Type of encryption.

Fields.Name: Smtp
Fields.Description: Whether SMTP authentication is enabled and `user`, `pass` are required.

Fields.Name: User
Fields.Description: SMTP username.

Cc

Fields.Name: Channel

Fields.Description: Custom HTML (overrides `text`). If null, no HTML MIME part will be added to the email.

Fields.Name: Interval

Fields.Name: Queue
Fields.Description: Queue the message to be sent later if it fails to send.

Fields.Name: Subject
Fields.Description: Subject line for the email message.

Fields.Name: Text
Fields.Description: Formatted to HTML using Markdown and rendered using default email template.

Fields.Description: Time limit for connecting to the SMTP server in seconds.
